messages:
ida: Quick idea — run a 30-min "Launchpad" webinar that feels like a sprint. 3 micro-demos (7 mins each) + 10-min live Q&A. Goal: showcase pragmatic inference wins (latency/cost, quantization tradeoffs, embedding UX) and give attendees concrete next steps. Need speakers + 1-sentence abstracts by EOD Friday.
sam: Love it. Proposed working title: 'Launchpad — Pragmatic Inference for Product Teams'. Also thinking: split registration form to capture use case (benchmarks, embeddings, private deploy).
marco: I can bring a customer case (FinTech) for demo 3 — will ping Maya now. Rehearsal preference: Wed 9am PT works best for me.
ava: Ops note — we must have a robust demo fallback: cached responses + a short recorded snippet to play if live generation lags. Also confirm streaming vs full-response mode for demo 1 (benchmarks).
ops-bot: calendar: "Launchpad rehearsal — tech & full run" created for Wed 2024-05-15 09:00 PT — https://calendar.internal/evt/4721
ida: Draft abstracts to iterate on — rough take: 
- Demo A (benchmarks): "How we cut end-to-end token cost 3x by combining adaptive batching and prefix caching without raising p99 latency" (1 sentence)
- Demo B (quant/quality): "When quantization helps (and when it subtly breaks) — practical guardrails for product teams" (1 sentence)
- Demo C (customer): "Embedding-powered search: a live customer story hitting 50ms first-answer with routing fallbacks" (1 sentence)
I need 1-2 sentence versions from each speaker by EOD Fri.
sam: For inbound lead routing: please tag registrants with interests — e.g., `interest_benchmarks`, `interest_embeddings`, `interest_enterprise`. Send `interest_benchmarks` -> SDR Queue A, others -> Queue B. Also include UTM param `utm=launchpad_bench` on reg link.
marco: Run-of-show suggestion (compact):
```
00:00 Host intro (ida)
03:00 Demo 1 - Benchmarks (sam)
10:00 Demo 2 - Quant & Quality (sam/marco)
17:00 Demo 3 - Customer (marco + customer)
24:00 Live Q&A (panel)
30:00 Close & CTA (register trial / request demo)
```
ida: Nice. Need a fallback script in case Demo 1 flops — 3 lines to pivot into talking points + play a 90s recorded clip of the demo. Also prepare 5 test prompts/inputs per demo to validate in rehearsal (edge cases + noisy input).
ava: Rehearsal plan:
- Tech-check (30m) — test streaming, mic, recording capture, fallback playback.
- Full run (45m) — timing, transitions, panel cues.
I'll also put together a 5-item test vector CSV we can run against the staging endpoint.
sam: I'll draft registration copy + CTA. Also want to A/B test two subject lines for invites: short vs descriptive. I'll include a hidden field to capture 'marketing_source' for routing.
marco: Speaker outreach: I'll DM Maya and Jae now. Anyone else to recommend? @ida if fine, I'll copy in PR contact for the customer clip.
ida: Approved — go ahead. Also ask analytics to add conversion events: `webinar_registered`, `demo_clicked`, `lead_sdr_queue` so we can measure funnel.
ops-bot: reminder: rehearsal tech-check scheduled 48h before live.
sam: Quick note — recording edit: keep 2-min highlight reel for on-demand; ops please capture separate audio tracks.
ava: Confirming: I'll upload the test vectors and the fallback clips to the shared drive by EOD Thu.
marco: Got it, pinged speakers.
ida: Great — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
